Aisha: Quick follow-up from the regional failover postmortem. Need owners + dates for remediations & recurring-pattern tagging.

Marco: Root cause summary: route-selection flip during cutover because tie-break logic preferred stale RIB entries. Also saw one bad snapshot manifest.

Devon: I'll take the tie-break logic fix in the control plane. ETA 2026-04-12. Will include an automated CI check.

Hannah: I'll own snapshot manifest verifier and a pre-runbook snapshot health check. Target 2026-04-03.

Aisha: Can we add a game-day pre-cutover traffic sample step? That would've caught the steering mismatch.

Marco: Yes — adding a mirroring sample to the game-day checklist. Due 2026-03-30.

Devon: I'll also add a CI regression that simulates route-reflector churn and verifies symmetric paths.

Hannah: Snapshot verifier will run as a pre-mark hook before snapshots are marked "ready". I'll open GH issue and small PR.

Aisha: Canonical AI list (will import to GH Projects + label "regional-failover-audits"):

```
AI-301 | Control-plane tie-break fix                  | owner: Devon  | due: 2026-04-12
AI-302 | Snapshot manifest verifier                   | owner: Hannah | due: 2026-04-03
AI-303 | Game-day pre-cutover traffic-sample         | owner: Marco  | due: 2026-03-30
AI-304 | Runbook: explicit rollback signals          | owner: Aisha  | due: 2026-04-05
AI-305 | Warm-standby cost sketch (ballpark)         | owner: Aisha  | due: 2026-04-06
```

Marco: I'll add the mirroring config snippet to #eng-runtime and request a quick hardware check if soft-mirror not available.

Devon: CI test will be in the infra-regressions job; tagging @Marco for review.

Hannah: Noted blocker: object-store eventually-consistent windows might need stronger checks. I'll include retry logic.

ops-bot: Calendar: dry-run reserved 2026-03-31 10:00-12:00 UTC. Invites sent to @oncall, @Devon, @Hannah, @Marco.

infra-bot: Incident 2026-03-28-REGFAIL: closed -> follow-ups created: 5.

Aisha: We'll run a short status check in this thread if any AI slips. Review in next DR sync on 2026-04-08.

Marco: Acknowledged.

Devon: PR draft incoming this week.

Hannah: Will post issue + PR link when ready.

Aisha: Thanks team. Closing thread unless blockers surface.
